summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_9 fixes, run with Playwright at 400x860 on the preview URL. PASS (1) One-shot guard: in a fresh Easy run (rulesetId easy-v3), at W1 I entered a battle, set pending.enemies[0].atk/spd to 999, reloaded, then continue -> MANTIENI -> auto. The log read: 'Jim Wraith usa Tiro Fantasma!' -> 'Mark Evans resiste con 1 HP!' (no 'è KO!' for that hit) -> Mark uses Mano di Luce -> second enemy hit -> 'Mark Evans para parte del colpo!' -> 'Mark Evans è KO!' (0/108 HP). BattleScreen.jsx:127 now filters the 'è KO!' message, so sfx.ko is no longer triggered for the guarded hit. PASS (2) Crests: the 'Royal Academy · Ricognizione' miniboss crest shows 'RA' (bg rgb(67,56,202)). In act 3 with seed 7919, Epsilon Kai is rgb(31,41,55) with red initials 'EK' (rgb(248,113,113)), clearly distinct from Prominence rgb(160,0,0) with white 'P'. Dark Emperors is #1A1A1A with 'DE'. No page errors.

issues: Optional: the Epsilon Kai (#1f2937) and Dark Emperors (#1A1A1A) backgrounds are both near-black. The red versus light-grey initials and borders still tell them apart, so this is acceptable.

critical_code_review_comments: The guard filter uses m.endsWith('è KO!'). This is correct for the current engine.js message format. If that message text changes, the filter breaks silently, so consider a Jest test for it.
seed_data_creation: None. Only browser localStorage was used, in disposable Playwright contexts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach the act 3 intro: start an Easy run, click act-intro-start, then set run.overworld.contentSeed=7919, wave=21, completedWave=20, path=[], introSeen=2 and pending=null. Reload, then continue-run-btn. The guard test flow is in the summary.
